facts.fact: The printed 'Business and housing lending GLAs and deposits' chart shows business lending of $155.0bn at Sep-24 and $166.3bn at Sep-25, labelled 6.7% growth; the same page prints 'Revenue' of $8,358m in FY24 and $8,531m in FY25, up 2.1%, and 'Cash earnings' of $3,277m and $3,330m, up 1.6% (NAB/FY25/investor-presentation, PDF page 49).

replies.question: stated
replies.why: Note says business lending rose 7.3% to $166.3bn, not 6.7% growth from $155.0bn; revenue and cash earnings match.

replies.question: entailed
replies.why: Quotes show business lending growth as 7.3%, not 6.7%, and omit Revenue figures entirely.

replies.question: stated

replies.question: entailed
replies.why: Quotes lack revenue figures and the 6.7% growth rate for business lending.

facts.fact: The printed 'Net interest margin' bars are 3.11% in 1H24, 3.07% in 2H24, 3.01% in 1H25 and 3.02% in 2H25; 'Credit impairment charge and as a % of GLAs' prints $237m/0.18% in 1H25 and $292m/0.21% in 2H25 (NAB/FY25/investor-presentation, PDF page 49).
